description: This file defines an interface class 'IFactories' within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, which provides factory methods for creating web request/response objects, file bodies, and JSON-RPC messages. It also includes deprecated type definitions for WorkerPool and Factories.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class providing factory methods for web request/response handling, file bodies, and JSON-RPC messages within the WPEFramework plugin host.

methods.description: Checks if the IFactories instance is available.

methods.name: Response
